name: Northern Lights CO2 transport and storage, Norway (Equinor/Shell/TotalEnergies)
description: world's first merchant CO2 transport and storage: Phase 1 up to 1.5 Mtpa (operational 2024, first injection August 2025); March 2025 FID on a USD 714 m expansion for 900 kt/yr biogenic CO2 over 15 years; Phase 2 to lift capacity to at least 5 Mtpa from 2028

sources.note: Equinor Northern Lights page (1.5 Mtpa, expansion to min 5 Mtpa); ogj 27 Mar 2025 (USD 714 m FID); TotalEnergies notice 25 Aug 2025 (first CO2 storage); read 2026-10-28
